payload.summary: Implemented packed review packets, concurrent dispatch_and_wait, and verify-then-wire structured-output flags. Two 2s stub vendors overlap at ~2.0s. Claude and Antigravity gained --json-schema; Codex --output-schema was verified but not wired (file path vs inline sentinel).
completed_work: structured-output probe table and agents.yaml wiring

decisions.title: Packet markdown is the dispatch prompt
decisions.rationale: converge() builds review_packet.py output and passes the body as prompt; packet_path is optional kwargs.

decisions.title: Thread pool concurrent dispatch with async submit-then-poll
decisions.rationale: D2: wall clock is max(vendor). Async vendors must not submit+poll one-by-one.

decisions.title: Wire only empirically verified schema flags
decisions.rationale: Claude and agy accept --json-schema; Codex needs a file path the sentinel cannot supply; pi --mode json is NDJSON.
